name: 2D/3D Canary Islands
summary: Need a vacation but no time or opportunity to travel? Then take a virtual trip to the Canary Islands. The app shows videos of the aquarium in Loro Park on Tenerife, the aquarium on Grand Canaria, the promenade on Grand Canaria, Orca Show and more... Some of the videos were recorded in 4K ProRes and were rendered in maximum quality in the AV1 codec.
